mandate: C316 — test the cross-sectional SIZE / VOLUME / TURNOVER (liquidity) statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1440 pre-registered configs). Signals: size (-log trailing notional), amihud (|ret|/notional), turnover (volume/|price change|), volume (log volume), vwap_dev ((close-vwap)/vwap). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs charged on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy variants). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and size-vs-illiquidity-vs-turnover/volume-vs-placebo attribution.

methodology.signals: size=-log(trailing-L mean notional); amihud=trailing-L mean(|ret|/notional); turnover=trailing-L sum(volume)/trailing-L sum(|price change|); volume=log(trailing-L mean volume); vwap_dev=trailing-L mean((close-vwap)/vwap); causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i (pos>0 long).
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-positive notional/volume/vwap treated as NaN; never divide by zero, never fabricate; a lookback without enough valid observations yields NaN -> not traded.
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs flat (0); Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1440 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config vs amihud vs turnover/volume vs placebo (per-asset randomly permuted perp returns, same reference positions); shares = |net| / sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.funding: USDT-M funding unreachable (fapi 451, not in archives) -> excluded (control only).
